import json
base=[[':method','POST'],[':scheme','https'],[':authority','demo.test'],[':path','/']]
base_size=sum(len(n)+len(v)+32 for n,v in base)
vlen=8192-base_size-len('x-note')-32
fields=base+[['x-note','a'*vlen],['content-length','32768']]
# Note: adding CL means this exceeds the section limit; reduce x-note accordingly.
vlen-=len('content-length')+len('32768')+32
fields=base+[['x-note','a'*vlen],['content-length','32768']]
assert sum(len(n)+len(v)+32 for n,v in fields)==8192
events=[]
body=bytes((i%256 for i in range(32768)))
for j in range(256):
    sid=4*j
    events.append({'sid':sid,'type':'headers','fields':fields})
    remaining=len(body)
    for k in range(14):
        n=remaining//(14-k)
        events.append({'sid':sid,'type':'data','hex':body[:n].hex()})
        body_chunk=body[:n]
        # Each stream gets the same deterministic content; only local slicing is needed.
        body=body[n:]
        remaining-=n
    assert not body
    body=bytes((i%256 for i in range(32768)))
    events.append({'sid':sid,'type':'fin'})
assert len(events)==4096
with open('/workspace/tmp/stress.json','w') as f: json.dump({'routes':{'https://demo.test':'rack-a'},'events':events},f,separators=(',',':'))
